ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms a score threshold, a timeout policy and the unrun-mutant flag are declared; it does not run mutation testing.
offer: Define the score threshold and inconclusive-result policy before the run. A timeout or unrun mutant cannot be silently counted as acceptable enforcement evidence.

minimal.reason: Set the minimum mutation score percent, at least 70. A lower bar accepts weak tests, so choose a documented threshold.

mid.reason: State the policy for timed-out mutants. Without it a timeout silently counts as acceptable, so decide killed, survived or inconclusive.

maximal.reason: Set allowing unrun mutants to false. A mutant that never ran is no evidence, so count it as a gap.
